name: Singing lead sustain
desc: Pedal-style compressor before a fuzz or drive: long notes hold and bloom, a hot front end for endless sustain

refs.why: Gilmour's compressor pedal into a fuzz for the solo's sustain
refs.source: Guitar World feature, reprinted in Australian Guitar, 2021

notes: Long release so the gain rises slowly as the note decays: sustain without an audible swell
